description: Price cells and return a ready-to-send x402 request (URL, method, headers, JSON body, exact amount). Nothing is reserved or charged. Send it with an x402 client (x402-fetch, x402-axios, @x402/fetch); it pays and creates the order in one request. Raise the client's max amount if the price is above its default cap (x402-fetch 0.10 USDC, @x402/fetch 1 USDC).

accepted_terms.description: Must be true: you accept the terms (https://cellionaire.com/terms).

areas.description: One to 20 non-overlapping areas, each a rect + color and/or a list of cells with colours.

cells.description: Individual cells, each with its own colour (instead of or in addition to rect + color).

color.description: Colour of every cell in "rect", "#RRGGBB" (required with rect).

rect.description: A rectangle of cells: top-left x, y and width w, height h (cells).

owner.description: Public display name shown on the cells (max 40 characters). Default "anonymous".

name: prepare_x402_order
title: Price cells for an x402 payment
